crossRefs.note: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?
“Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
“Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

translations.web: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”
translations.bsb: If this is not so, then who can prove me a liar and reduce my words to nothing?”
translations.kjv: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
translations.asv: And if it be not so now, who will prove me a liar, And make my speech nothing worth?
